title: Trust and Safety Schedule for Wayfare Driver Agreements: Report Categories and Limits
content:
Safety reports about a driver under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product fall into categories that either place the agreement on hold at once or lead to a warning. The same categories and limits apply on every Wayfare level.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Categories that place the agreement on hold at once pending investigation | harassment; impairment allegation; physical altercation; discrimination | same four | same four | same four | same four | same four |
| Categories that lead to a warning unless repeated | unsafe driving; unauthorized rider | same two | same two | same two | same two | same two |
| Warning-category reports within the lookback that place the agreement on hold | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Lookback for counting warning-category reports (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Longest a safety hold may last before Trust and Safety must release or deactivate (calendar days) | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |

### Points of reading

- A report in a hold category acts at once; a single report is enough.
- Reports in the warning categories are counted over the 30-day lookback; at 2 such reports within the lookback the agreement goes on hold.
- The 14-day figure is the longest a safety hold may last before Trust and Safety must release or deactivate.

Hypothetical reading: one unsafe driving report and one unauthorized rider report, both within the last 30 calendar days, make 2 warning-category reports within the lookback.
